# Ashlr MD

> An open-source, AI-native Markdown app for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/README.md): Features, setup, development, and architecture.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/AGENTS.md): Connect and use AI agents with Ashlr MD.
- [Installation](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Per-OS installation instructions.
- [Obsidian](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/OBSIDIAN.md): Obsidian compatibility details.
- [Phantom](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/PHANTOM.md): How Ashlr MD plugs into Phantom.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidance.
